caption:
This is what nobody tells beginners: your first home can be a 2-family.

My first home was a 2-family in New Jersey, so I became a landlord too. My mistake? I waited too long to set up online rent payments to track my tenants' rent. If I did it again, I'd set that up from day one.

Thinking about a 2-family for your first home? Talk to a licensed lender for your numbers.

DM me "HOME" to get started.
